name: Flag AI replies in Slack when tool actions did not finish

parameters.content:
## Flag AI replies in Slack when tool actions did not finish

### How it works
For teams whose AI agents send, refund, book or delete things and then tell the customer it is done. A webhook receives the agent's final reply plus a tool log, or a saved n8n execution with a node map. A Code node, with no AI key, finds completed action claims such as sent, refunded, booked, all set, or phrasing such as your refund has been processed. An optional actions array is graded against the tool log, with the verb list as a backstop. Each result is graded. An HTTP 200 body that reports failure is not treated as finished. A claim needs a finished result with a provider id (S3). Delivered wording needs a later check (S4). Unsupported pay or delete claims are marked stop-ship. Gaps go to Slack. Every check is added to a Google Sheet. Future tense and negated wording are not claims.

Limits: this checks a finished reply; it cannot recall a sent message. Targets are only as good as the tool log or node map. Only the first output item of each node is read. Replies with no action claims pass unless a structured actions list is sent.

### Setup
1. In Config, set the Slack Incoming Webhook URL, spreadsheet ID, sheet name, the default node map and the failure marker list.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Append to Google Sheet.
3. Add this header row to the sheet tab: timestamp, receivedAt, source, verdict, stopShip, claims, gaps, gapRate, reply, report.
4. Activate, POST a test payload to `/webhook/say-do-check`, and confirm the JSON response.

### Customization
Edit `notifyOn` (`gaps`, `stop_ship` or `always`), the default node map, and the failure marker list. Call this webhook after the agent node finishes.

## 1. Receive and check
The webhook accepts a reply plus a tool log, or a saved execution plus a node map. All user values live in Config.

## 2. Return the verdict
Responds with pass, review or stop_ship, the findings and the text report, so a calling workflow can hold a send.

## This is a check, not a recall
It flags a finished reply. It cannot pull back a message that already went out. Run it before you send.

nodes.name: Warning: This does not unsay a sent message

parameters.content:
## 3. Review gaps in Slack
Posts only when Config.notifyOn matches (gaps by default, or stop_ship, or always).

## 4. Log every check
Adds one row per request: pass, review or stop_ship, with the report text.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
Edit these values before activating.
slackWebhookUrl: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for your review channel (keep it private).
spreadsheetId: the ID from your Google Sheet URL.
sheetName: tab that receives the log rows.
notifyOn: when to post to Slack. Use gaps (any unsupported claim), stop_ship (only pay or delete gaps), or always.
sourceLabel: written to the sheet when the payload has no source field.
defaultNodeMap: JSON that names the reply node and each action node, used when the payload sends an n8n execution and no nodeMap of its own. See Setup for the shape.
failureMarkers: JSON list of body fields that mean the tool did not finish, even when HTTP is 200. The default list covers ok false, success false, status error or failed, a present error field, and a nonempty errors list. Replace the list to match your APIs. An empty list turns off body checks; HTTP 4xx or 5xx and a failed status string still count.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ verdict: $json.verdict, stopShip: $json.stopShip, claims: $json.claims, gaps: $json.gaps, gapRate: $json.gapRate, findings: $json.findings, duplicates: $json.duplicates, report: $json.report, reply: $json.reply, source: $json.source }) }}

nodes.name: Post Gaps to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts to the Slack Incoming Webhook URL set in Config, so no Slack app credential is needed.

nodes.notes: Connect Google Sheets OAuth2. Spreadsheet ID and tab come from Config. Header row: timestamp, receivedAt, source, verdict, stopShip, claims, gaps, gapRate, reply, report
